policy.template_source_rule: Only add a source-exact implementation when the source is explicitly open-source and its license permits modification and redistribution.
policy.fidelity_rule: For permitted open-source templates, preserve layout, spacing, typography treatment, animations, scroll animations, hover effects, responsive behavior, and interaction timing; change only content and colors unless the license or technical integration requires otherwise.
policy.asset_rule: Use assets only when their licenses permit redistribution; replace non-redistributable assets with appropriately licensed real assets without changing the surrounding layout geometry.
